Venus, Mesa's Vulkan driver for virtio-gpu (src/virtio/vulkan), from Mesa
26.2.4 (https://mesa3d.org/), used under the MIT licence.  Not vendored
whole: tools/build_venus.py fetches the release tarball (checking its
SHA-256), applies novaos.patch, adds vn_renderer_nova.c and builds
vulkan_virtio.dll, 64- and 32-bit, with MinGW-w64.  The result, venus.7z,
is the App Store's "Venus" (the CI publishes it beside nova.iso).

vn_renderer_nova.c (MIT, NovaOS's own): Venus's renderer back end for
NovaOS, in place of Linux's virtgpu (DRM) and vtest ones.  It asks the
kernel's virtio-gpu driver (kernel/drivers/virtio_gpu.c, through
kernel/um/um_gpu.c's NtNovaGpuCtl, found in ntdll) for a 3D context on the
Venus capability set, submits Venus's command streams, creates and maps
blobs (a mappable one comes back as a section that NtMapViewOfSection
maps) and uses the kernel's timelines for Vulkan's timeline semaphores and
fences.  It also stubs three SPIR-V specialization helpers the Windows
link wants but Venus never calls.

novaos.patch changes:
- src/virtio/vulkan/meson.build: build vn_renderer_nova.c on Windows.
- src/virtio/vulkan/vn_renderer.h: vn_renderer_create() makes the NovaOS
  renderer on Windows.
- src/virtio/vulkan/vn_instance.c: VK_KHR_win32_surface (Venus's
  Windows build left it out; DXVK needs it).
- src/virtio/vulkan/vn_common.h: no sync files on Windows (sync_wait and
  sync_valid_fd say every fd is signaled; ETIME defined).
- src/vulkan/runtime/vk_instance.c: with VK_ICD_PRESENT_HOOK defined,
  vk_icdNegotiateLoaderICDInterfaceVersion asks that function whether the
  device is there and declines otherwise, so the Vulkan loader moves on
  to the next driver (lavapipe) on a machine without a 3D virtio-gpu.
- src/vulkan/wsi/wsi_common_win32.cpp: MinGW-w64's d3d12.h instead of the
  DirectX-Headers project's (the DXGI swap chain path is not used; images
  are presented through GDI), and a present on a GPU's CPU image waits for
  the copy into it to finish (Mesa waits only on a software device).

The 32-bit build links with --kill-at, so the vk_icd* exports have no
stdcall @N suffix (Mesa's own .def files do that for its other drivers).
